newsitem.title: MEXICO: Gruma to secure $120 mln syndicated loan.
newsitem.headline: Gruma to secure $120 mln syndicated loan.

text.p: Mexico's Gruma SA de CV on Tuesday said it was set to sign an agreement for a $120 million syndicated loan to refinance existing credits and provide future financing for the company.
Bank of America will lead the lending syndicate, the company said.

"The credit will be signed, tentatively on May 30. It is for $120 million and will be used by Gruma SA de CV and Grupo Industrial Maseca," Raul Cavazos Moral, Gruma's deputy finance director, told Reuters.
The credit will be available for three years, but the company will have the option of renewing it for another year, Cavazos Morales said.
The interest rate is seen at the London Interbank Offered Rate (Libor) plus 125 basis points.
Another 19 banks will take part in the syndication of the loan.
Cavazos Morales said the company had received proposals from a number of banks for credits worth $229 million, but decided to stay with the initial amount it had planned to borrow.
